exposure: spinal anesthesia (2.2 mL of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine and morphine 0.2 mg)
outcome: Amount of opioid consumption (measured as milligrams of morphine equivalent [MME]) within the first 24 hrs after cesarean section
cohort: 1530 pregnant women who had a cesarean section under the same regimen of spinal anesthesia (2.2 mL of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine and morphine 0.2 mg)
finding: ABO blood group is not a predictive factor for opioid requirement within the first 24 hrs following cesarean section.
